title: feat(console): Save to this view on a shared view asks once, then saves and publishes it; layout and row colour join the list draft (#35955 PR 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuG6LywHEovAnGuZpiKQEc2W)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWyeXh2Keywo6oK1Nn

Part of #35955 (PR 2 of three: PR 1 #36026 made a list change a draft; PR 3 retires the server-side list preference and runs in parallel. The card stays open.)

Clause-②: yes (widening) — five new `console.objectView.draft.*` keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` locale pack (`saveToViewConfirmTitle`, `saveToViewConfirm`, `saveToViewConfirmButton`, `savedForEveryone`, `pendingDraft`); `@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView` gains the optional host prop `onRowColorChange` and two optional `viewDefaults` members, `viewType` and `rowColor`; nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 共享视图上，能改这个视图的人（管理员，且视图所在的包接受保存）在「保存 ▾」里也看到「保存到这个视图」：先问一次「所有用这个视图的人都会看到」，确认后存并立刻发布，提示「已保存，所有人可见」。选项菜单里的「保存」同一条路。
- 这个视图已有没发布的修改（谁存的都算）时什么都不写，提示先去视图设置里发布或放弃；不替任何人发布。保存人的行高、列宽不会写进共享视图。
- 显示面板的「布局」「行颜色」现在也是草稿：点开记录再回来还在，两条「保存」都会存进去，「放弃」还原成视图自己的。

## What changes

**Save to this view on a shared view** (`ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`)

- Offered when `canSaveToSharedView`: not an environment list, not a personal view, and the same test the footer calculation's pick uses (`isAdmin && !activeViewPackageRefusesSaves && isSavedViewId(savedViews, id)`), so a read-only package's view and the fallback tab never get it. A personal view keeps its own save. The phone / narrow `Save ▾` is the same component; the options menu's Save calls the same handler.
- It asks once through `confirmHandler` (`saveToViewConfirmTitle` / `saveToViewConfirm` naming the view / `saveToViewConfirmButton`, cancel `console.objectView.cancel`).
- The body is the view's own config with the draft laid over it (`layListStateOverView`, split out of `buildPersonalViewConfig`), then `buildViewConfigSaveBody`, the body the view settings panel saves. The reader's row height is left out (`rowHeight: undefined` on the laid preference, F5); column widths never travel.
- New `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata(type, name, body, ctx)`: a draft write with the first-write pin (`{ mode: 'draft', ifNoneMatch: '*' }`), then `publish`. A `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` on the write means a draft is already pending; it resolves `'pending-draft'` and nothing is written or published. A publish the server refuses discards the draft this save wrote (`reset(type, name, { state: 'draft' })`) and rethrows. Caches are invalidated and the draft ledger announced on both paths.
- `handleViewSaveAndPublish` shows the saved body at once (`setViewDraft`) and lets `handleDraftBarChange` drop it when the saved-views re-read lands (#36031), so the list does not flash the old sort. On `'published'` the list draft is dropped (`handleResetView`) and "Saved, visible to everyone" is toasted; on `'pending-draft'` the draft stays and `pendingDraft` is toasted.
- Using the server's pin instead of a client read of the draft closes the read-then-write window the premise read named (P4). The window left is between this save's draft write and its publish: the view settings panel writes its draft without the pin, so a settings save landing in those milliseconds would overwrite this draft and be published with it. A known edge, not closed here: card #36137.

**Layout and row colour join the draft** (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `ListView.tsx`, `personalViews.ts`)

- The renderer wires the published `onViewChange` to `listDraft.patch({ viewType })` and the new `onRowColorChange` to `listDraft.patch({ rowColor })`; picking the view's own value drops the entry. The draft's values go to `ListView` as `schema.viewType` / `schema.rowColor`, and the view's own through `viewDefaults.viewType` / `viewDefaults.rowColor`, so the `layout` / `rowColor` parts and the Display count still judge against the view after a remount.
- `ListView`: `onRowColorChange` fires on a pick in the row colour panel (the rule in force) and on Clear (`null`), never at mount or for a reset. Each new `viewDefaults` member is read only when its key is present; without them nothing changes.
- Both saves read them: `PersonalViewListState.display` carries `viewType` and `rowColor`; a layout switch retypes the view and fills the kanban / gallery mirror from the saved columns when the block lacks one (`IN_PLACE_COLUMN_MIRRORS`). Save as my view builds from `listDraft.draft.viewType ?? activeView.type` and passes the row colour.

**i18n**: the five keys in all ten hand-written packs; zh-Hant regenerated (`pnpm gen:zh-hant`).

**Docs**: `ui/packages/plugin-list/README.md` (new host-props section), `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (§ "A user's list state never writes the view"), `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` revision 14 (steps[8], acceptance[5], negative[4]; not loosened).

## Tests

- New `ObjectView.sharedViewSave-35955.test.tsx` (8): confirm, then `save(... { mode: 'draft', ifNoneMatch: '*' })` then `publish`, body carries the draft sort and the view's own row height `short` while the reader's stored one is `tall`; cancel writes nothing; pending draft (409 `METADATA_CONFLICT`) writes nothing more and toasts; refused publish resets the draft; a read-only package's view is not offered; layout and row colour laid into the schema and `viewDefaults` and kept across a remount; picking the view's own value drops it; the save retypes to kanban with its columns mirror and the row colour.
- `runtime-metadata-persistence.test.ts` (+4): published; pending-draft; a `409` with another code (`DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`) rethrows; refused publish resets and rethrows.
- `ListView.personalization-28950.test.tsx` (+4): the `rowColor` part judged against `viewDefaults`, a control without them, `onRowColorChange` on pick and on Clear (`null`), and no call at mount.
- `ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx` (+1): the draft row colour reaches the personal save and Save as my view.
- L1-b S1 (`ObjectView.sharedViewSave-35955.test.tsx` +3, `ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx` +2): the confirm and Save as my view's default name read the view's tab label (`listLabel`, `viewTabLabel`), with a view that has no label and one whose label is a locale map (plus a plain-label control on the confirm). Ablated: the raw label turns the locale-map confirm case and both copy-name cases red. In the shared-view harness a stored view with no label already arrives named by its name, so that case is a pin, not a discriminator.
- `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx` (+2, G2): a reload whose address was rewritten before the seed applies its `uf_*` state; a reload on a record page then Back applies the list entry's `uf_*` state. Pins of current behaviour, no behaviour change.

## Acceptance notes

- P3 (seat 14:28Z): any pending draft refuses, the saver's own earlier draft too; the server does not record a draft's author.
- F5: a shared save never carries the saver's row height or column widths; a personal save still carries the row height, as on main.
- The view settings panel and the footer calculation still save a shared view as a draft that the view settings publish (ruling 7045525672 unchanged).
- Not touched: where column widths, row height and the view order are stored (PR 3).
- Landing order with #36133 (PR 3): both bump `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` to revision 14 and edit the same section of `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`. Whichever lands second renumbers to 15 and merges the two history entries.
- L1-b N1 taken: the pending-draft test is `isDraftVersionConflict` from `DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, the predicate the other draft-door callers use.

## Verification

CI and local runs at head `da8b797b`; the S1 commit's tests and type check at `0ada6797`.

- CI: every check green (54 passed, 10 skipped by path), mergeable clean. The first head (`433d7c02`) went red on four pins, each fixed in its own commit: the `rowColor` firing control in `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts` now reads `const viewOwnRowColor = viewDef.rowColor ?? listSchema.rowColor;` (the relay reads the view's own rule once, so the draft's can lie over it); the de quote-pair count in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` goes 120 to 121 for `saveToViewConfirm` („{{name}}“); three `viewDefaults` equalities in `ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx` gain `viewType`; a checker narrowing in the new test is read through a cast. No pin was loosened: each asserts the same thing at the new spelling.
- Local (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView*`, `runtime-metadata*`, `personalViews*`, `listDraft*`, `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView*`): 237 files, 2290 tests; the only 3 failures were the `viewDefaults` equalities above, 40/40 after the fix. `packages/i18n`: 105 files, 1962 passed. `packages/types` 7779: 236/236.
- `pnpm --dir ui/packages/app-shell run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui/packages/plugin-list run type-check` exit 0 (both include `tsconfig.test.json`).
- eslint on every changed `ui/` source and test: 0 errors. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:new-line-citations` exit 0; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` OK.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --base=origin/main`: clean against main `dc10b3b4` and open #36114, #36105, #36096, #36024.
- Clause-② measured on the built `ui/packages/plugin-list/dist/ListView.d.ts`: `onRowColorChange` and the two `viewDefaults` members are added, optional; no member removed or narrowed. The seat runs the declaration L2.
- Browser, at `0ada6797` (showcase `objectstack dev`, the `ui/` HMR console pointed at it; checklist `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` steps[8]), on a shared view the admin created and published (`showcase_task.team_tasks`, package `com.example.showcase.custom`):
  - admin, sort by Priority: Save offers "Save to this view"; the confirm reads "Everyone who uses “Team tasks” will see these changes."; confirming sends `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.team_tasks?mode=draft` with `If-None-Match: *` (200) then `POST …/publish` (200) and toasts "Saved, visible to everyone"; Discard and Save go.
  - a second reader who is not an administrator (`phone.demo@example.com`) opens the view sorted by Priority, and after a sort of their own is offered only "Save as my view". Control: on the read-only package's `showcase_task.in_progress` the admin is offered only "Save as my view" too.
  - with a draft of the view already pending, the admin's confirmed save gets `409` on the pinned `PUT`, sends no publish, toasts the pending-draft hint and keeps Discard and Save; the pending draft is still there afterwards and the live view unchanged.
  - Not driven in the browser: the row height (F5) and the layout and row colour round trip, pinned in the unit tests above.
